Enjoy the evergreen track “Dil Sachaa Aur Chehra Jhutha” from Sachaa Jhutha (1970) starring Rajesh Khanna and Mumtaz. Sung by the legendary Kishore Kumar with music composed by Kalyanji-Anandji, this timeless melody captures the charm and style of Bollywood’s golden era. A classic that continues to win hearts across generations.
